dashboard.title: 🔧 Pipeline Monitoring Dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitoring pipeline data: log execution, job status, resource usage. Memantau severity log (INFO, DEBUG, WARNING, FATAL).

panels.title: Airflow Job Status (24h)
panels.description: Jumlah DAG run sukses dalam 24 jam terakhir.

panels.title: Failed Tasks (24h)
panels.description: Jumlah task gagal dalam 24 jam. Jika > 0, perlu investigasi.

panels.title: Log Severity Distribution

targets.query: from(bucket: "pipeline-logs") |> range(start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log_count") |> group(columns: ["severity"]) |> sum()

panels.description: Distribusi severity log pipeline: INFO, DEBUG, WARNING, FATAL. Penting untuk memantau kesehatan pipeline.

panels.title: Spark Job Duration
panels.description: Durasi job Spark dalam detik. Lonjakan durasi bisa menandakan bottleneck.

panels.title: Kafka Message Lag
panels.description: Consumer lag Kafka. Lag tinggi menandakan stream processing tidak dapat mengejar produksi data.

panels.title: MinIO Storage Usage
panels.description: Total penyimpanan yang digunakan di MinIO bucket.

panels.title: Data Freshness (Last Batch)

targets.query: from(bucket: "pipeline-metrics") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "batch" and r._field == "last_run") |> last()

panels.description: Timestamp batch terakhir yang sukses. Jika > 24 jam, pipeline mungkin bermasalah.

panels.title: Data Quality Score

targets.query: from(bucket: "pipeline-metrics") |> range(start: -1d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "data_quality" and r._field == "score") |> last()

panels.description: Skor kualitas data berdasarkan null rate, type errors, dan duplicate rows.
